course_name_original: Machine practicum _ learning and artificial intelligence on the (FMFI.KAI/1-AIN-306/22)
course_name_en: Machine Practicum _ Learning and Artificial Intelligence

learning_outcomes.text: Students will acquire basic skills in working with basic libraries for 2D and 3D data processing (images, scans): OpenCV and PCL.
They will be able to use it in various programming projects using artificial intelligence methods, especially machine learning results.

syllabus_topics: Image representation and its processing, color models, conversions between them
Morphological operations with image and contour detector and structural analysis
Image segmentation. MeanShift filter. GrabCut. Intrinsic image.
Image alignment and registration. Phase correlation. ECC. Image features: SIFT, SURF, BRIEF, ORB.
Camera and video. Optical flow. Stereovision. Camera calibration
Machine learning: PCA, eigen images, SVM, cascade regressor
Object detectors. Hough's transformation. Haarov detector. HOG detector. LBPH
Tracking the movement of objects. Kalman filter. CamShift. MIL tracker. Motion detector.
Use of deep learning models: Colorization, YOLO detectors, vectorization and recognition, EAST text detector, Tesseract OCR, GOTURN
Usage of deep learning models: background removal, 3D reconstruction from 2D, 2D pose estimation, semantic segmentation.
Representation of 3D data and method of their acquisition. Reconstruction of 3D models, 6 DoF position estimation for gripping parts
Applications: tracking the movement of cars from traffic cameras, tracking eye movement, processing 3D scans of characters
assessment_rules: The final grade is based on a 50/50 split between preliminary assessment (homeworks) and final assessment (exam). The indicative evaluation scale is A for 90%, B for 80%, C for 70%, D for 60%, and E for 50%.
